meaning:
θόρυβος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
a noise, uproar, tumult, as of an excited mob: Mat.26:5 27:24, Mrk.14:2, Act.20:1 21:34 24:18; of mourners, = ὄχλος θορυβούμενος, Mrk.5:38.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
